!!! warning "Volume swing against the median month: bioinfo +104%"
    Check the harvest before reading anything into this. A swing this size is usually indexing lag or a broken query, not the field going quiet. The known benign case is `bioinfo` every January, which carries the Nucleic Acids Research database issue.

Largest contributors: Nucleic Acids Res 374, Nature 125, JAMA 119, Science 104, Bioinformatics 72, Lancet 56.
